wiki_catalogs.name: Architecture Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: High-level system architecture showing how Next.js App Router, Prisma, Bull queues, and authentication integrate together.

wiki_catalogs.name: App Pages and Routes
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Complete route map covering all page routes, server actions, and API endpoints.

wiki_catalogs.name: Exercise Catalog
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Action (exercise) model with muscle mappings, equipment requirements, rig types, and search capabilities.

wiki_catalogs.name: Progression Strategies
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Detailed documentation of the simple progression strategy for strength, mass, and loss training goals.

wiki_catalogs.name: Shared Components
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Reusable UI components in src/components/ including Layout, AuthProvider, and feature-specific components.

wiki_catalogs.name: Data Model
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Comprehensive overview of the Prisma schema covering User, Action (exercises), Training lifecycle, Execution tracking, Scoring, Periods, and Equipment.

wiki_catalogs.name: Equipment Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Per-user equipment sets with rig capabilities and weight constraints.

wiki_catalogs.name: Scoring and Analytics
wiki_catalogs.prompt: How exercise performance is normalized and scored using log-scaling and purpose-specific coefficients.

wiki_catalogs.name: Core Business Logic
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Document the pure business logic layer in src/core/ including scoring normalization, progression strategies, and statistics computation.

wiki_catalogs.name: Training Execution Flow
wiki_catalogs.prompt: End-to-end workflow of a training session from creation through execution to completion and score calculation.

wiki_catalogs.name: Background Job System
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Bull queue architecture for asynchronous processing of scores, period checks, and image cleanup.

wiki_catalogs.name: Authentication and Authorization
wiki_catalogs.prompt: NextAuth.js integration with GitHub/Google OAuth, session management, and role-based access control.
